description: PROP-E1-cohealth-load-identity (required:true, verification-architecture.md L35) demands comparison of BOTH path-identity AND load-timestamp of ai.anicca.<slot>-core-healthcheck before/after. The test test_does_not_touch_core_healthcheck (test_install_integration_darwin.py:127-141) (a) only checks PID, not path and not load-timestamp; (b) skips entirely if cohealth is not loaded (line 131-132), giving zero coverage in CI environments where cohealth is not preinstalled; (c) silently passes if either before- or after-PID regex doesn't match (line 139 'if pid_before and pid_after'). A bootout-then-rebootstrap of cohealth that re-acquired the SAME PID by coincidence — or that occurred while cohealth was idle (no PID line) — would pass this test while violating INV-6. Strengthen: assert path-identity unconditionally, parse load-timestamp / 'last exit code' line, fail loud (don't skip) when cohealth absent in production, or fixture-install a stub cohealth.
